gaps.where: Settings → Calendars, each calendar row's link with the copy icon; a calendar's Booking link card (Copy); Settings → Calendars → Booking site, the link with Copy
gaps.gap: The screens copy the whole link: origin plus bookingPath or permanentPath. The Assistant only ever gets paths. get_settings calendars returns calendar.list as is (bookingPath '/book/<site>/<cal>', permanentPath '/book/c/<id>'). get_settings booking_site returns site.path '/book/<slug>'. get_calendar_settings returns no link at all. The context's calendar lines have no link either. Read tools are run without webUrl, and nothing the model reads names app.handsfreeos.com. The only full-URL logic (branded domain when verified and the certificate is ready, else webUrl) lives in send_form, a commit. With no branded domain the model can't know the address. With one, it has to build the URL itself.
gaps.fix: Factor tools-forms.ts:381-388 into a helper publicOrigin(db, ctx, webUrl). Pass webUrl through createToolExecutor.run to settingsReadTools and calendarReadTools (tools-write.ts:886-899). In tools-settings.ts:130 give calendars a shape that adds bookingUrl and permanentUrl. In tools-settings.ts:134 give booking_site one that adds site.url. Add bookingUrl to get_calendar_settings' calendar block (tools-scheduling.ts:452). Put each calendar's bookingUrl on its context line (context.ts:291-316, prompt.ts:238-251).

gaps.where: The Assistant's own instructions on writing links, and its words about Your own web address
gaps.gap: The SYSTEM prompt's only link example is https://handsfreeos.com/book/acme. handsfreeos.com is the marketing site (urls.site), and the app is https://app.handsfreeos.com (urls.app, WEB_URL). Several other places teach the same wrong default domain: settings-map.ts:141 ('instead of handsfreeos.com'), the manage_branded_domain description (core tools-setup.ts:244), and the worker's branded-domain cards and outcomes (tools-setup.ts:1747, 1797, 1842). update_booking_site shows 'Address: /book/<slug>' on its card and returns 'Your booking page is at /book/<slug>', paths only.
gaps.fix: prompt.ts:49: use https://app.handsfreeos.com/book/acme as the example. Add one rule under 'How to write': a customer-facing link is copied whole from a tool result (bookingUrl, permanentUrl, site.url) and never built from a path or a guessed domain. Change 'handsfreeos.com' to 'app.handsfreeos.com' in settings-map.ts:141, core tools-setup.ts:244 and worker tools-setup.ts:1747, 1797 and 1842. In tools-settings-calendar.ts:939 and :968, show and return `${publicOrigin}/book/${slug}`; commit already has extra.webUrl (tools-write.ts:917), and prepare needs it passed.

gaps.where: Settings → My calendar: Weekly hours, Time zone, Time off (each row with its trash button), 'No hours saved yet, so weekdays 9 to 5 apply'
gaps.gap: get_settings my_calendar runs schedule.team with no input. ScheduleTeamInput requires from and to, so the query fails validation every time. readArea catches the failure as null, and the answer says 'Not this person's to see: schedules. An owner or admin can.' So the person's own weekly hours, ownTimezone, defaultHours and time off (with ids) are never readable. Because no tool returns an exception id, remove_time_off can't be used. A set_hours change to one day ('Fridays off') has to resend the whole week blind. The worker already makes this call correctly in savedWeek (tools-settings-me.ts) and busyText (tools-calendar.ts). The area test only checks result.area, so the failure goes unnoticed.
gaps.fix: tools-settings.ts:224: add input: (ctx) => ({ from: iso(now - 1 day), to: iso(now + 60 days), userIds: [ctx.actor.userId] }), as my-calendar/page.tsx:39-45 does. Add a shape returning { timezone, ownTimezone, weekly, defaultHours (as 'No hours saved yet, so weekdays 9 to 5 apply'), timeOff: [{ exceptionId: id, startsAt, endsAt, allDay, note, kind }] }. Describe update_my_hours.exceptionId (tools.ts:1121) as 'from get_settings (my_calendar) timeOff'. In assistant-settings.test.ts, assert that get_settings my_calendar has a non-null schedules and no note.

gaps.where: Phone app: a visit's screen (Calendar → press an appointment), with Ask HandsFreeOS in its top bar
gaps.gap: The phone opens a visit at /app/w/<ws>/calendar/<appointmentId>, and its Screen shows Ask HandsFreeOS (ask defaults to true). usePhonePageRecord passes that pathname to assistantPageRecord, which only knows calendar?appt=<id>. RECORD_ROUTES has no calendar prefix, so the record is null. The turn then says 'No customer, lead or appointment is on screen.'
gaps.fix: In assistantPageRecord (words.ts:437), add a match for /^calendar\/(UUID)(?:\/|$)/i returning { type: 'appointment', id }. Add at(`calendar/${ID}`) to packages/core/test/assistant-words.test.ts:208-217. Update the doc comment at words.ts:422-427.

gaps.where: Calendar → an appointment: Reminders (Confirmation and each reminder: Scheduled, Sent by text or email at a time, Skipped and why, Replaced); Customer: 'Confirmed by text 4:12 PM', 'Confirmed by Priya', 'Not confirmed · Asked Tue 4:00 PM, no answer yet' or 'Not asked yet'
gaps.gap: Real: get_appointment drops each attendee's reminders (ReminderState: confirmation and each reminder, scheduled, sent or skipped, the channel, dueAt, the reason) and confirmAskedAt. It also turns confirmedAt and confirmedBy into 'yes, by someone on the team', with no time and no name. So 'Did we ask Mike to confirm?', 'Why didn't her reminder go?' and 'When is it due?' can't be answered. Overstated: a reminder that was sent is a real message (ReminderEntry.messageId), so get_conversation can show it went out. Scheduled and skipped reminders, and why, are still invisible.
gaps.fix: In get_appointment's customers (tools-scheduling.ts:400-409), add attendeeId: s.id; askedToConfirmAt: s.confirmAskedAt; confirmedAt; confirmedBy: s.confirmedBy?.fullName; and reminders: [confirmation, ...Object.entries(s.reminders.reminders)] mapped with core's reminderLabel and reminderWhy to { label, state, channel, at or dueAt, why }. Drop entries whose startsAt isn't the visit's current start, as the sheet does. A wider one-line alternative: add 'appointment.get' to SCREEN_READS so read_appointment_get returns AppointmentGetOutput whole.

gaps.where: Calendar and the visit sheet: status badge 'Not booked yet' and 'Waiting on a deposit. Held until 3:10 PM · 12 minutes left to pay it'; 'Happening now'; Scheduled / Completed
gaps.gap: Real: statusWords and todays_schedule ignore heldUntil. A time held while the customer pays a deposit comes back as 'Booked' from list_appointments and get_appointment, and as 'scheduled' from todays_schedule and upcomingFor. Every screen says 'Not booked yet' or 'Waiting on a deposit… Held until 3:10 PM'. The words also differ from the badges: 'Booked' and 'Done' against 'Scheduled' and 'Completed'. Overstated: todays_schedule does return happeningNow, so 'Happening now' isn't lost there, only in list_appointments and get_appointment. update_appointment already refuses to confirm a held seat.
gaps.fix: Replace statusWords (tools-scheduling.ts:180-190) with core's statusOf, holdOf and holdWords (calendar/agenda.ts:126-186), using the calendar's zone. Return status as the label ('Not booked yet', 'Happening now', 'Scheduled', 'Completed', 'No-show', 'Cancelled'), and add held: holdWords(...) when holdOf is non-null. Do the same in appointmentResult and todaysAppointments (tools-calendar.ts:197-206, 242-246).

gaps.where: Calendar → Team, Week, Day and Month: each person's hours ('8 AM–6 PM' or 'Off'), time off blocks with their note, 'Busy in Google Calendar'/'Busy'/'Busy in another business' blocks, 'No calendar linked', and the reconnect notice
gaps.gap: No Assistant tool reads teammates' hours, time off with notes, or busy spans. schedule.team is not in SCREEN_READS. The only places it's read are get_settings my_calendar (self-only and broken, see cal-3), savedWeek (self) and busyText (one span, inside a booking card). list_team returns only names and roles, and find_availability only open slots. 'Who's off next week?' or 'Why is Priya blocked at 2?' can't be answered, though the Calendar's Team, Week and Day views show it to anyone with workspace.read.
gaps.fix: Add 'schedule.team' to SCREEN_READS (screen-reads.ts). This makes read_schedule_team with from, to (62 days or less) and userIds. Overlap with own reads is allowed, as calendar_connection.list shows. A worker list_team_schedule shaped to { name, userId, hoursToday or weekly, timeOff [{ startsAt, endsAt, allDay, note }], busy, busyElsewhere, privateBusy, connection status } would read better.

gaps.where: Reschedule dialog (and drag or resize on the grid): Date, Start, Length, Time zone, the 'Tell Maria' tick box; 'Who's going?' (Change) with 'Tell Maria'
gaps.gap: reschedule_appointment takes only appointmentId, startsAt and userIds. It can't change the length, though appointment.reschedule takes durationMinutes and the Move dialog has Length (and resize). It always sends notify: true to appointment.reschedule. It sends notify true to appointment.reassign when the time is unchanged, with no way to untick Tell. Changing only who goes needs startsAt resent, and the card always says the customer is told.
gaps.fix: In tools.ts:1364-1371, add durationMinutes: minutes.optional() and tellCustomer: z.boolean().default(true). Make startsAt optional, with a refine that requires startsAt, durationMinutes or userIds. In tools-calendar.ts move() (:752-779), skip appointment.reschedule when neither startsAt nor durationMinutes is given. Pass durationMinutes, and notify: tellCustomer, to reschedule; pass reassign notify: tellCustomer && sameStart. Use tellRow(..., tellCustomer, ...) on the card (:804) and in same_time, comparing length too.

gaps.where: New appointment: Location (the calendar's places, editable customer address), Time zone pick ('a customer's 2 PM Pacific'), Customer (optional)
gaps.gap: Real: book_appointment has no timezone. A customer's '2 PM Pacific' books on the calendar's clock, and the confirmation and reminders tell it in the calendar's zone (appointment.create takes timezone, and manage_repeat_visits already has timeZone). personId is required, but the dialog books with no customer. There is no location at booking: only the customer's own address is filled, and only when the first place is customer_address. Overstated: the place and title can be changed after booking with update_appointment (location: Place, title). Even then, the confirmation has already gone out with the default place.
gaps.fix: In tools.ts:1345-1361, add timeZone: timezone.optional() (described as in manage_repeat_visits), location: Place.optional() (import Place from tools-scheduling.ts:26), and make personId optional. In bookingInput (tools-calendar.ts:589-607), pass timezone: args.timeZone, and prefer args.location (mapped meetingLink→meetingUrl, as update_appointment does) over the customer address. When personId is missing, skip person.get and the Tell row (:612-616).

gaps.where: Members → ⋯ → Edit hours, and Settings → My calendar?user=… for a teammate: their Weekly hours, Time zone, Add time off, remove time off
gaps.gap: Owners and admins (calendars.manage) set a teammate's weekly hours, time zone and time off from Members → ⋯ → Edit hours (my-calendar?user=…). schedule.set and time_off.add take ownerKind and ownerId, and the kernel allows it with calendars.manage. update_my_hours says 'Theirs alone', and the worker always acts on the asker. No other tool calls schedule.set, so 'Dale works 7 to 3 now' can't be done, while the settings map points people to the screen.
gaps.fix: Add userId: uuid.optional().describe('A teammate (list_team); owners and admins only') to update_my_hours (tools.ts:1095-1125). In tools-settings-me.ts, when userId isn't ctx.actor.userId, pass ownerKind 'user' and ownerId to schedule.set and time_off.add. Have savedWeek read that user's schedule. Title the card with their name and change the outcome words ('Dale’s hours are saved'). Leave the permission check to the kernel (assertMayEditHours).

gaps.where: A group session's Seats: Attended and No-show beside each person (and the phone's same buttons)
gaps.gap: do_attendee_set_attendance needs attendeeId (the seat id). get_appointment returns each customer's personId, name, status and seats, but not s.id, and no other read returns an attendee id. 'Mark Sam attended the class' can't run, though the Seats section has Attended and No-show beside each person.
gaps.fix: In get_appointment's customers (tools-scheduling.ts:400), add attendeeId: s.id and joinedAt: s.joinedAt. Mention 'attendee ids for do_attendee_set_attendance' in get_appointment's description (core tools-scheduling.ts:58).

gaps.where: Visit sheet → Job: 'Visits in this job' (date, title, status) and 'Add another of their visits' (+ each other visit)
gaps.gap: get_appointment's job returns only status, the customer note and a count of visits. It has no job id, no list of visits and no otherVisits (all in JobOut), and no etaAt. do_job_add_visit needs jobId and appointmentId, so 'add Tuesday's visit to this job' can't run, and 'what other visits are in this job?' can't be answered.
gaps.fix: In tools-scheduling.ts:410-416, return job: { jobId: a.job.id, title, status, noteForCustomer, eta (etaAt), visits: a.job.visits.map(v => ({ appointmentId, when, title, status })), couldAdd: a.job.otherVisits.map(v => ({ appointmentId, when, title })) }.

gaps.where: Visit sheet: the deposit block (Deposit paid, Due after the visit, Open the invoice), the job invoice (Invoiced, Paid, Balance), and Invoice this visit
gaps.gap: get_appointment drops priceCents and reads no money for the visit. The sheet reads money.for_record with recordType 'appointment': deposit paid and when, due after the visit, and the job invoice with its balance. customer_money reads only per person and lists only open invoices, so a paid deposit isn't there. write_invoice has no attendeeId or purpose, so it can't do Invoice this visit (a draft tied to the seat, 'balance' less the paid deposit). The sheet's billable check is !money.jobInvoice, so an Assistant-written invoice leaves Invoice this visit showing, and the visit can be billed twice.
gaps.fix: Add 'money.for_record' to SCREEN_READS, or in get_appointment also query money.for_record { recordType: 'appointment', recordId } and return priceCents plus { deposit: depositWords(...), dueAfter: dueAfterCents(...), jobInvoice: jobInvoiceWords(...) } with core's helpers (visit-money.tsx:17-27). Add appointmentId to write_invoice (core tools-billing.ts:170-186). For a one-customer visit, the worker then sets attendeeId (seat id), leadId and purpose 'balance' when the deposit is paid ('standard' otherwise), with the line less the deposit, as invoiceThisVisit does.

gaps.where: Calendar page with no appointment open: the view (Day, Week, Month, Team, Resources), the date in the title, the Person picker, the calendar chips (all in the URL)
gaps.gap: On /calendar with no ?appt, the page record is null. The view, date, Person and calendar chips in the URL never reach the turn, which says 'No customer, lead or appointment is on screen.' This is a design limit of the record-only page context, not wrong behaviour. The person can name the day or the teammate, and list_appointments and find_availability then answer. So it's lower than medium.
gaps.fix: Extend PageRecord with an optional calendar view: in the web's usePageRecord (apps/web/src/lib/assistant/page-record.ts:14-20), send parseCalendarQuery's view, date and userId. Add a pageLines case (prompt.ts:190-212): 'On screen: the Calendar, Week of Nov 9–15, Dale Ortiz (user id …). “This day” or “this week” means that.'

gaps.where: Visit sheet: 'Booked online' / 'Booked by AI' chip, People and equipment (roles Lead/Crew/Host, each resource with 'N reserved'), 'Also on this visit' (extra services with length, price, 'added by the AI teammate'), the line under the time ('30 min travel before and after')
gaps.gap: appointment.get has source, resources (with quantity), staff roles, extraServices (minutes, price, source), and bufferBefore and bufferAfter. get_appointment and its card return none of them, so 'Did the AI book this?', 'Which truck is on it?' and 'What else did they add?' go unanswered. Correction: createdBy isn't shown on the sheet, so it isn't part of the gap.
gaps.fix: In get_appointment (tools-scheduling.ts:384-428), add bookedBy: sourceLabel(a.source) (or 'Booked online' or 'Booked by AI'), with: a.staff.map(s => ({ name, role: host→'Lead' or 'Host', crew→'Crew' })), equipment: a.resources.map(r => ({ name, quantity })), alsoOnThisVisit: a.extraServices.map(x => ({ name, minutes: x.durationMinutes, price: money(x.priceCents), byAi: x.source === 'ai_teammate' })), and buffers: { before, after } (marked travel when the calendar's travelMinutes applies).

gaps.where: Phone app, a visit's screen: Check in (showing safety: where, planned end, who is told)
gaps.gap: safety.check_in (risk 1, workspace.read, actors human) is in no tool, SCREEN_ACTIONS or NEVER entry. The Assistant can extend, check out of and resolve a check-in, but can't start one. It only tells people to press Check in on the phone. The coverage test misses this because it scans only '/v1/commands/<name>'. The phone runs offline commands through change('<name>', …), registered in apps/mobile/src/changes/commands.ts. Other phone-only commands also go unchecked and appear in no Assistant source, for example safety.where, safety.help, safety_contact.save and remove, appointment.still_going (a push button), call.connect_me and lead.record_answers.
gaps.fix: Fixed: my_check_in (action start) runs safety.check_in for the person’s own check-in, with appointmentId from todays_schedule, and ask_for_help and manage_my_safety_contacts run safety.help and safety_contact.save and remove (the safety-team step); appointment.still_going is a screen action and call.connect_me is on NEVER_FOR_THE_ASSISTANT. A check-in starts without the phone’s location: sharing where the phone is (safety.where) is now on NEVER_FOR_THE_ASSISTANT, since only the phone in their hand knows where it is, and assistant-coverage.test.ts reads what the phone sends straight away ({ name, commandId }, safety/follow.ts) as well as its change() calls, so it can’t go unchecked. lead.record_answers is in the phone’s list of changes, but no screen on the web or the phone sends it: the AI teammate records a lead’s answers itself (apps/worker/src/ai-team/tools.ts).
